judge.method: self-judged visual inspection of the Chrome render; strict per-requirement pass/fail

requirements.text: Create a classic rubber ducky shape with a distinct body and head, colored bright yellow.
requirements.note: A recognizable bright-yellow duck has a large body and distinct raised head.

requirements.text: The duck must have an orange beak and a simple black dot for an eye.
requirements.note: The eye is obscured by the tub rim and is not visible as a simple black dot.

requirements.text: Draw a white, claw-foot bathtub shape, showing the inside view with a visible rim.
requirements.note: The white tub has a visible inside and rim, but its supports are not recognizable claw feet.

requirements.text: Fill the lower portion of the bathtub with light blue water.
requirements.note: The lower tub is filled with light blue water.

requirements.text: Ensure the water line is clearly visible across the duck's body, showing the lower third of the duck submerged.
requirements.note: The water line crosses substantially above the lower third of the duck's body.

requirements.text: Position the duck so it is floating on the water's surface, creating small, concentric circular ripples in the water around its base.
requirements.note: The duck floats, but the nearby marks are overlapping wave curves rather than small concentric circular ripples.

requirements.text: Depict soap bubbles as clusters of overlapping circles with a slight iridescence, using semi-transparent white, light pink, and light blue fills.
requirements.note: The overlapping bubbles use white and blue tones, but no light pink fill is visible.

requirements.text: Place a small cluster of bubbles on top of the duck's head.
requirements.note: No bubble cluster is placed on the duck's head.

requirements.text: Place a large pile of bubbles against one side of the tub and a few floating on the water's surface around the duck.
requirements.note: Large overlapping bubble groups sit at the tub sides, with smaller groups on the water.
